notes_for_orch:
*** T0031 — HONEST OUTCOME: projection delivered, real co-synth blocked by tool crashes ***

WHAT HAPPENED (3 synth attempts):
  v1: Vivado multithread helper failed to read its own scripts/rt/data/lib_core.tcl (intermittent helper-spawn race; file exists).
  v2: single-threaded got further — then ERROR 8-439, '<top>_sdiv_..._ip' not found. HLS softmax divide infers a Xilinx Divider LogiCORE, delivered as XCI/IP netlist not plain RTL. The raw HLS Verilog alone is incomplete.
  v3: I wrote port-compatible behavioral divider stubs. Synth elaborated the design, printed the Part Resource Summary, then Vivado CRASHED (EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT). Likely cause: thousands of dangling ap_memory ports (xmod_attn Q/K/V 64 banks each, vit_encoder 48 weight arrays x8 banks, ...) at the integration boundary overrunning a tool limit on this 16 GB host.

ROOT LESSON: HLS-generated RTL is NOT meant to be hand-instantiated into a parent netlist. The supported path is Vitis HLS export_design -> packaged IP-XACT -> Vivado IP integrator, where ap_memory/ap_ctrl interfaces get proper adapters and the divider LogiCORE is generated by the tool. That is a genuine multi-hour engineering flow.
